_comment: Audited official programme facts, applied only to records whose official source host matches exactly.
_rules: Only facts verified on the awarding body's own page during a live research pass are listed. Anything marked unverified in the research was left out rather than guessed.
A facts entry only fills a field that is currently NULL. It never overwrites a value the scraper already read from the official page, because the page is the fresher source.
Deadlines are cycle-specific. Each entry states the cycle it was verified against so a stale value is recognisable rather than silently presented as current.
Amounts are the awarding body's published figure for that cycle and are labelled per_cycle where the value can change year to year.
Matching is by exact official source host. A record from chevening.org cannot pick up Commonwealth facts, so a wrong entry cannot be applied to the wrong programme.

chevening.org.official_source: Chevening, UK Foreign Commonwealth & Development Office
chevening.org.benefits: Full tuition, 12-month living allowance, flights, visa and departure grant
chevening.org.eligibility: Bachelor's degree plus at least two years (2,800 hours) of work experience. Applications are made to one UK university and one Chevening country award.
chevening.org.deadline_cycle: 2027-28 applications, verified open 4 Aug 2026 to 6 Oct 2026 11:00 UTC

cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk.official_source: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk.benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend (GBP 1,712, GBP 2,000 in London) and airfare
cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk.eligibility: Citizen of a Commonwealth Scholarship Commission country holding a master's-equivalent degree. Applicants must also secure a nomination from an approved nominating body.
cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk.deadline_cycle: 2027 cycle, applications 8 Sep to 20 Oct 2026, 16:00 BST

sbfi.admin.ch.official_source: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SBFI), Swiss Confederation
sbfi.admin.ch.eligibility: National of a country that has an agreement with Switzerland. Research Scholarships are open to master's and doctoral candidates; no postdoctoral awards from the 2027/28 call.
sbfi.admin.ch.deadline_cycle: 2027-28 call, opened 20 Aug 2026; deadline set per country, example 30 Nov 2026

nawa.gov.pl.official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
nawa.gov.pl.benefits: PLN 2,500 per month plus tuition exemption and PLN 2,500 travel allowance
nawa.gov.pl.eligibility: Citizens of listed developing countries without Polish citizenship, holding a first-cycle diploma from 2024 onwards. The Stefan Banach Programme funds second-cycle (master's) and preparatory studies.

campusfrance.org.official_source: Campus France, French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
campusfrance.org.benefits: EUR 2,500 per month for 12 months plus a EUR 500 installation allowance
campusfrance.org.eligibility: MOPGA (Make Our Planet Great Again) grants. Doctorate defended between December 2021 and December 2026, non-French national, not resident in or active in France, and no previous MOPGA award.
campusfrance.org.deadline_cycle: MOPGA 2027 call, 15 Sep to 15 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET

foreign.fulbrightonline.org.official_source: United States Department of State, administered by IIE
foreign.fulbrightonline.org.benefits: Tuition, maintenance, airfare and health insurance
foreign.fulbrightonline.org.eligibility: Fulbright US Student Program. United States citizens or permanent residents returning to study in the United States, applying to a degree programme.

studyinkorea.go.kr.official_source: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Republic of Korea
studyinkorea.go.kr.benefits: Tuition, monthly stipend, settlement and return allowance, airfare and insurance
studyinkorea.go.kr.eligibility: Global Korea Scholarship, University track (GKS-U). Applicants from eligible countries holding a secondary-school qualification awarded within the last three years, who must depart for Korea in the same year.
studyinkorea.go.kr.deadline_cycle: GKS-U 2027, 15 Sep 11:00 KST to 30 Sep 18:00 KST

csc.edu.cn.benefits: Tuition, accommodation, stipend, insurance and airfare
csc.edu.cn.eligibility: Chinese Government Scholarship. Applicants are nominated by their embassy (Type A) or by the host university (Type B).

turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.official_source: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB)
turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.benefits: Tuition, accommodation, meals, health insurance, airfare and stipend
turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.eligibility: Turkiye Scholarships for international students. Turkish citizens receive first priority, followed by eligible foreign nationals aged 17 to 30.
turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.deadline_cycle: Standing annual window, 10 January to 20 February; 2026 cycle closed 20 Feb 2026

stipendiumhungaricum.hu.official_source: Tempus Public Foundation, Government of Hungary
stipendiumhungaricum.hu.benefits: Full tuition waiver, monthly stipend in HUF and travel contribution
stipendiumhungaricum.hu.eligibility: Stipendium Hungaricum covers bachelor's, master's, one-tier master's, doctoral, non-degree and postgraduate specialist studies. Academic track record, language proof and motivation required; applications are routed through a Sending Partner.

moe.gov.sa.official_source: Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
moe.gov.sa.benefits: Tuition, accommodation, stipend, medical care and flights
moe.gov.sa.eligibility: Saudi Government Scholarship for public universities, open to applicants from any country except the health and medical specialisations. Deadlines are set by each university.

marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.benefits: Salary and allowances per European Commission rules for postdoctoral fellows
marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eligibility: Postdoctoral researchers who completed their PhD and satisfy the mobility rule, having carried out their main research activity outside the country of the host institution in the last three years.

marshallscholarship.org.benefits: Full costs of study including tuition, living stipend, travel and health insurance
marshallscholarship.org.eligibility: United States citizens with a bachelor's degree, within three years of graduation, who have not previously studied in the United Kingdom.
marshallscholarship.org.deadline_cycle: 2027 cycle, applicants and recommenders 29 Sep 2026; institution endorsement 1 Oct 2026

rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk.benefits: All costs of a postgraduate degree at Oxford including fees, living stipend and airfare
rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk.eligibility: Rhodes Scholarships. Academically strong candidates with a demonstrated record of leadership. Applicants apply through one constituency only.

knight-hennessy.stanford.edu.benefits: Full funding including stipend, tuition and health insurance
knight-hennessy.stanford.edu.eligibility: Knight-Hennessy Scholars. Applicants to a Stanford graduate degree programme with applied leadership, academic excellence, and four experiences with different Stanford faculty.
knight-hennessy.stanford.edu.deadline_cycle: 2027 entry, Knight-Hennessy application 6 Oct 2026 13:00 PT; Stanford degree application by 1 Dec 2026

us.fulbrightonline.org.official_source: United States Department of State, administered by IIE
us.fulbrightonline.org.benefits: Tuition, maintenance, airfare and health insurance
us.fulbrightonline.org.eligibility: Fulbright US Student Program. United States citizens or permanent residents who will return to the United States to study.

ethz.ch.benefits: CHF 12,000 per semester for the full study and living cost, plus a tuition fee waiver for the regular four-semester duration
ethz.ch.eligibility: Excellence Scholarship and Opportunity Programme for the ETH Global Master's. Applicants need an outstanding academic record, and the November window is mandatory for this scholarship and for all holders of a bachelor's degree from outside Switzerland.
ethz.ch.deadline_cycle: ESOP November window, 1 to 30 Nov 2026, 11:59 CET

epfl.ch.benefits: CHF 10,000 per semester together with guaranteed housing
epfl.ch.eligibility: Master's Excellence Fellowship for students beginning a master's programme with remarkable academic results and notable extracurricular activity. Open to international applicants and applied for through the master's application form.
epfl.ch.deadline_cycle: First round 15 Dec 2026, recommendation letters 31 Jan 2027; second round 31 Mar 2027

ukri.org.benefits: A fellowship salary at the standard UKRI rate, plus research costs and access to institutional facilities
ukri.org.eligibility: UKRI Early Independence Fellowships, open to researchers of any nationality based at a UK research organisation eligible for the relevant council's funding.
ukri.org.deadline_cycle: 2026 Early Independence round, closes 30 Sep 2026, 16:00 UK

sarao.ac.za.benefits: R488,000 per year plus a R67,000 annual travel grant and a one-off R40,000 equipment grant, over three years
sarao.ac.za.eligibility: Freestanding postdoctoral fellowships at South African universities, endorsed by a host or supervisor, in radio astronomy or engineering for radio telescope and geodesy instrument operations. Must commence in South Africa on or before 1 October 2027.

canoncollins.org.benefits: R20,000 to R100,000 depending on circumstances, for up to two years of master's study or three years of doctoral study
canoncollins.org.eligibility: Southern African nationals committed to development, studying full-time or part-time at a recognised institution. Distance learning is considered. The Tom Queba and Pegasys Scholarships for Social Change run the same deadline.

mastercardfdn.org.benefits: Tuition, a laptop, on-campus accommodation, living expenses, medical aid, study visa and annual travel to and from the host university, renewed annually
mastercardfdn.org.eligibility: African citizens, including South Africans, applying to a first bachelor's degree or an eligible taught postgraduate programme, who show academic talent, significant social or economic barriers to opportunity, ethical leadership and community commitment. Admission and scholarship are separate applications.
mastercardfdn.org.deadline_cycle: University of Cape Town 2027 programme, bachelor's deadline 30 Sep 2026; postgraduate diploma, honours and coursework master's 31 Oct 2026

mandelarhodes.org.benefits: Full costs of study including fees, living support and travel, plus a structured leadership development programme
mandelarhodes.org.eligibility: African nationals with a record of leadership and service, undertaking postgraduate honours or master's study in any field at a selected South African institution.
mandelarhodes.org.deadline_cycle: 2028 intake, applications 9 Mar to 14 Apr 2027, 23:59 GMT+2

oas.org.benefits: Up to USD 10,000 per academic year, for one to two academic years
oas.org.eligibility: OAS Academic Scholarship Program for graduate studies and research. Citizens or permanent residents of OAS member states with a bachelor's degree already obtained. Recipients must return to and remain in the sponsoring country for at least 24 months.
oas.org.deadline_cycle: Set by each National Liaison Office in the applicant's own country; there is no single global deadline

isdb.org.benefits: Full tuition, books and equipment, medical insurance, a monthly living allowance in US dollars, a settlement allowance and return airfare, set per award letter
isdb.org.eligibility: IsDB Scholarship Programme for member countries, and the Scholarship Program for Muslim Communities in non-member countries. Applicants must sign a surety bond and accept within one month of the offer letter.

f-i-a.or.jp.benefits: Tuition remission for one academic year, worth about USD 12,800 for the intensive English programme, USD 8,900 to 18,000 for graduate study and USD 40,000 to 45,000 for undergraduate study
f-i-a.or.jp.eligibility: Fukui Findlay Scholarship for residents of or graduates of Fukui Prefecture who must work in the prefecture or intend to return its benefits, with a GPA of at least 3.0 out of 4 and a recognised English test score. Japan-resident applicants only; there are no overseas applications.
f-i-a.or.jp.deadline_cycle: 2027 study period, applications 20 Jun to 31 Oct 2026

jasso.go.jp.benefits: JPY 48,000 per month for the Honors Scholarship for Privately-Financed International Students, or JPY 80,000 per month for the Student Exchange Support Program
jasso.go.jp.eligibility: The Honors Scholarship requires a privately-financed international student with good grades who is nominated by their enrolling school; individual students cannot apply. The exchange programme is applied for by the host Japanese institution, never by the student.
jasso.go.jp.deadline_cycle: No applicant-facing deadline. The Honors Scholarship is school-nominated and follows the EJU application periods; the exchange programme is applied for by the host university

mext.go.jp.official_source: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology of Japan
mext.go.jp.benefits: JPY 143,000 to 145,000 per month for research students depending on level, with tuition, admission fees and airfare covered; JPY 117,000 per month for university, KOSEN and specialised training students
mext.go.jp.eligibility: MEXT Scholarship Research Students and University Students. Applicants must hold the nationality of a country with diplomatic relations with Japan, meet the age principle and years-of-schooling requirements, and apply through their embassy or a designated route.
mext.go.jp.deadline_cycle: There is no single deadline. Each Japanese diplomatic mission sets its own closing date for its own country, typically in April or May

campuschina.org.benefits: Tuition waiver, accommodation, stipend and comprehensive medical insurance. Airfare is not included
campuschina.org.eligibility: Chinese Government Scholarship for non-Chinese citizens in good health, with age limits by level, a CSCA certificate for bachelor's applicants and an HSK certificate for Chinese-taught programmes. A pre-admission letter from a target university is mandatory.
campuschina.org.deadline_cycle: There is no single deadline. The closing date is set by the sending agency or embassy, which differs by country, generally falling between January and early April

hksargov.hk.official_source: Hong Kong SAR Government Education Bureau
hksargov.hk.benefits: HKD 40,000 per year for local students and HKD 80,000 per year for non-local students at degree level
hksargov.hk.eligibility: HKSAR Government Scholarship Fund for year two or above students on full-time publicly funded programmes, renewable annually on satisfactory performance.
hksargov.hk.deadline_cycle: No single application date. The Education Bureau distributes the fund to institutions and each sets its own deadline, running from mid to late September

postf.org.benefits: Full tuition for four semesters at master's or six at doctoral level, KRW 1,000,000 per month for 22 or 36 months, a KRW 1,000,000 settlement allowance and national health insurance. Airfare is not included
postf.org.eligibility: Non-Korean nationals from the Foundation's designated countries who have been newly admitted to a programme at one of six partner universities and are nominated by that university. Applicants cannot apply to the Foundation directly and the award cannot be held alongside GKS.
postf.org.deadline_cycle: No public application date. Deadlines are set by the partner university, which nominates the candidate, followed by a Foundation interview

gatescambridge.org.official_source: Gates Cambridge Trust, University of Cambridge
gatescambridge.org.benefits: Full tuition, maintenance of GBP 22,050 for twelve months, economy return airfare, inbound visa, Immigration Health Surcharge and academic development funding
gatescambridge.org.eligibility: Open to citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom for PhD, MLitt or a one-year postgraduate course at the University of Cambridge.
gatescambridge.org.deadline_cycle: 2027/28 international and US round 1, closes 14 Oct 2026, 23:59 UK

churchillscholarship.org.official_source: Churchill Scholarship, Winston Churchill Memorial Trust
churchillscholarship.org.benefits: Total value over USD 80,000 including tuition, roundtrip airfare, visa fees, Immigration Health Surcharge and a stipend above the UKRI standard, plus an optional USD 4,000 research grant
churchillscholarship.org.eligibility: United States citizens nominated by a Participating Institution, for a one-year MPhil or MASt in science, mathematics or engineering at Churchill College, Cambridge.
churchillscholarship.org.deadline_cycle: 2027 cohort, Foundation nomination deadline 2 Nov 2026, 17:00 Eastern

dzs.cz.official_source: DZS, Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports of the Czech Republic
dzs.cz.benefits: CZK 16,000 per month for bachelor's and follow-on master's studies in Czech, CZK 17,000 per month for doctoral studies in English, plus a one-year language and preparatory course at Charles University
dzs.cz.eligibility: Government of the Czech Republic Scholarship for foreign students, limited to nationals of Belarus (democratic forces), Bosnia and Herzegovina, Cambodia, Ethiopia, Georgia, Ukraine and Zambia.

scholarships.sk.benefits: EUR 620 per month for second-cycle students and EUR 1,025.50 for doctoral candidates, rising to EUR 1,470 for senior researchers, plus a distance-based travel allowance
scholarships.sk.eligibility: National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic, for international students, doctoral candidates, university teachers, researchers and artists at higher education institutions in Slovakia.
scholarships.sk.deadline_cycle: Summer semester round closes 31 Oct 2026, 16:00 CET

en.tka.hu.official_source: Tempus Public Foundation, Government of Hungary
en.tka.hu.benefits: HUF 56,600 per month for full-degree bachelor and master students, HUF 140,000 per month for doctoral candidates in years one and two rising to HUF 180,000 in years three and four, with tuition covered by the Hungarian state
en.tka.hu.eligibility: Bilateral State Scholarships for incoming full-degree, partial and study-visit applicants from countries named in each bilateral agreement. Some apply directly to the Foundation, others through a national scholarship office.

koneensaatio.fi.benefits: Personal grants of EUR 2,700, 3,200 or 3,800 per month by tier, and project grants typically of EUR 200,000 to 500,000
koneensaatio.fi.eligibility: Humanities, social and environmental sciences, artistic research and multidisciplinary art and research. The project must have a connection to Finland. Maximum four consecutive years.

fnr.lu.official_source: Fonds National de la Recherche, Luxembourg
fnr.lu.benefits: ATTRACT investigator grants of up to EUR 2,000,000 over five years, AFdoc funding for doctoral candidates, and PEARL support of EUR 3 to 4 million over five to seven years
fnr.lu.eligibility: FNR funding instruments require a clear link to Luxembourg and joint involvement with a Luxembourg host institution. ATTRACT is for researchers with two to eight years of proven research experience after their doctorate.
fnr.lu.deadline_cycle: ATTRACT 2027 pre-proposal 17 Nov 2026, full proposal 16 Feb 2027

arnastofnun.is.official_source: Arni Magnusson Institute for Icelandic Studies, Government of Iceland
arnastofnun.is.benefits: University of Iceland registration fees plus a monthly stipend covering room and board for one person, for one academic year and renewable for up to three years
arnastofnun.is.eligibility: Icelandic Government Scholarships for foreign students in the humanities, requiring at least one year of study and a basic level of Icelandic, with preference given to applicants under 35. United States citizens apply through Fulbright instead.
arnastofnun.is.deadline_cycle: Annual 1 December deadline, for study from September 2027 to May 2028

servizz.gov.mt.official_source: Government of Malta, ENDEAVOUR II Scholarships Scheme
servizz.gov.mt.benefits: Full tuition, travel and living support for postgraduate study at a local or foreign institution, co-funded by the European Social Fund Plus
servizz.gov.mt.eligibility: ENDEAVOUR II Scholarships Scheme for MQF Level 7 and Level 8 postgraduate study. Applicants must be able to begin within the eligibility window and hold an e-ID.
servizz.gov.mt.deadline_cycle: Fifth call closed 5 Jun 2026, 12:00 Malta time

fct.pt.official_source: Fundacao para a Ciencia e a Tecnologia, Portugal
fct.pt.benefits: Doctoral studentships of three to 48 months, annually renewable, covering a monthly stipend and research costs
fct.pt.eligibility: FCT PhD Studentships for Portuguese, European Union, third-state, stateless and political-refugee citizens who do not already hold an FCT doctoral studentship or a doctorate, and who must live permanently in Portugal for the domestic lines.

instituto-camoes.pt.benefits: A monthly stipend set by Board of Directors resolution, plus accommodation support
instituto-camoes.pt.eligibility: Scholarships for annual Portuguese language and culture courses at Portuguese universities, and research grants requiring a detailed work plan in Portuguese with two recommendation letters.
